_schema: Influencer outreach CRM. Statuses: to_enrich > to_contact > drafted (Gmail draft ready, awaiting Yagel send) > sent > replied > negotiating > deal | passed | no_reply. Routines update this file and commit.

_policy.sending: NEVER auto-send. Routines create Gmail DRAFTS only; Yagel reviews and sends.
_policy.first_email: gifting-first: offer 1-year premium code + ask their rates. No payment commitments in any draft.
_policy.deal_approval: any money/terms commitment requires Yagel's explicit OK in chat
_policy.language: write in creator's language per marketing/community-field-guide.md registers
_policy.voice: personal, specific to their content (reference a real post/video), no marketing-speak, per content-playbook.md blocklist

tiers.nano: 1K-20K followers: gift-only offer (1yr premium + audience code). Highest reply rates; volume tier.
tiers.micro: 20K-150K: gift + ask rates for a short video/story. Sweet spot for cost-per-install.
tiers.mid: 150K-700K: gift + rates; expect paid. Yagel approves any spend.
tiers.macro: 700K+: contact but expect agency/high rates; long game.

_policy.daily_volume: Up to 12 personalized drafts/day from personal Gmail (safe ceiling). Raise to 30-40/day only after dedicated outreach mailbox (hello@ai-manifest.com) is warmed.
_policy.outreach_mailbox_note: Migrating to info@ai-manifest.com; no outreach drafts in personal Gmail until this flag is true
